title: Production Administrator
description:
Job Description:

The Production Administrator is responsible for collecting, recording, validating, and reporting production data across the companies manufacturing operations. The role focuses on monitoring yields, waste, production outputs, and key operational metrics, ensuring that factory performance information is accurate, timely, and reliable.

The position will conduct routine audits of production records, analyse performance data, and provide management with clear reporting to support operational decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Monitoring, Data collection & Reporting
- Record and monitor production yields across all manufacturing departments.
- Track yield performance against established standards and targets.
- Investigate and document yield variances.
- Maintain accurate yield records and reporting systems.
- Gather production data from manufacturing operations.
- Record production outputs, waste levels, downtime, and throughput information.
- Produce daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports.
- Generate KPI reports and trend analysis for management.
- Ensure all reporting is accurate, timely, and consistent.

Auditing & Verification
- Conduct routine audits of production records and data collection processes.
- Verify the accuracy and completeness of production paperwork and system entries.
- Identify discrepancies and work with operational teams to resolve them.
- Support internal and external audits by providing accurate production information.

Performance Analysis
- Analyse production data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improved reporting accuracy.
- Monitor key factory metrics including:
- Yield
- Waste
- Production Output
- Downtime
- Material Usage
- Prepare summaries and reports for management review.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Experience working in a food manufacturing or production environment.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
- Ability to collect, organise, and interpret production data.
- Strong communication and organisational skills.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in production reporting, yield analysis, or factory administration.
- Experience using ERP or production management systems.
- Knowledge of manufacturing KPIs and production performance measures.

Personal Attributes

Methodical and highly organised.

Detail-focused with a commitment to data accuracy.

Confident working on the factory floor and within an office environment.

Able to work independently and manage multiple reporting deadlines.

Work Location: In person

title: Repairs Scheduler
description:
Repairs Scheduler

Full Time (37 hours per week)
Location - Bedford (Hybrid Working)
Salary - 28,882.35 per annum

This role is hybrid, working from our head office in Bedford and from home. You will be office-based until fully trained; once competent, you can adopt a hybrid working pattern, to be agreed with the Scheduling Team Leader.

There is a requirement to work a late shift from home (12pm - 8pm). In addition, one week in every four you will work half a day on a weekday and half a day on a Saturday. We can be flexible with this.

Make a real difference in our brand-new in-house repairs & maintenance service

Are you an experienced works scheduler with a background in dynamic scheduling systems and a passion for delivering excellent customer service? Do you want to be part of our in-house repairs & maintenance service, where your work makes a difference to our customers and you're valued as a key member of our workforce? If so, we want to hear from you!

Repairs and maintenance services affect our customers personally, impacting their quality of life and satisfaction with their homes. To provide the very best service possible, we are bringing our repairs and maintenance service in-house.

As a Repairs Scheduler you will be:
- Be a confident people person who works seamlessly with our tradespeople and sub-contractors.
- Scheduling the right colleague for each job and plan daily workloads efficiently and effectively.
- Helping maximise first-time-fix rates and minimise travel between jobs.
- Reducing disruption to customers by planning thoughtfully and communicating clearly.

What We're Looking for in a Repairs Scheduler:
- Experience of logistical planning or other comparable scheduling service.
- An organised approach to work, with a positive attitude and great time management.
- A strong, demonstrable commitment to excellence in customer service through empathetic and considerate approaches to jobs.
- Housing repairs and maintenance knowledge beneficial, but not essential.
- Good communication and IT skills.

Working pattern

Hybrid role: office-based during training, then a mix of office and home working (to be agreed). Late shift 12pm-8pm from home. One week in every four includes half-day weekday and half-day Saturday working (flexible).

Why Join Us?

At bpha, our values are at the heart of everything we do:
- We take responsibility: We do what we say and are accountable for our actions.
- We show empathy: We respect and listen to every colleague and customer.
- We are better together: We value diversity and achieve more as one team.
- We are ambitious: We strive for excellence and make a positive difference.

Employee Benefits

We believe in rewarding our team with more than just a pay cheque. In addition to a wealth of other benefits and as part of our commitment to your wellbeing and development, we offer:
- A competitive salary of 28,882.35 per annum.
- Annual leave entitlement of 28 days (increasing, with length of service to 33 days) PLUS paid bank holidays.
- Generous contributory pension scheme, with up to 12% contributed by bpha.
- Free private health care (family members can also be added at a cost).
- Free life assurance.
- Discounted gym membership.
- A range of free wellbeing services including digital gym and fitness classes.
- Hybrid working.

Are you ready to make a difference?

If you're ready to make a positive impact and develop your career in our team, we'd love to hear from you!

Please note that applications will be reviewed as received and as such bpha reserves the right to close applications prior to the advertised closing date upon identification of a suitable candidate.

Early applications are encouraged to avoid disappointment.

All offers will be subject to satisfactory pre-employment screening, including DBS check and references.

About Us

Fosterplus was founded in 1996 and has extensive experience as an independent fostering agency. Continuity is important to us, and we look to create it in everything we do - most critically, for the children and young people in our care.

Many children who enter our care have experienced a disrupted childhood, and our aim is to break this cycle and provide greater stability. We do this by carefully matching the right Foster Parents to the right children and making sure we're always on hand with support, guidance and help.

Our expertise helps ensure more successful placements - and that's exactly the sort of continuity we want. This commitment is reflected in our mission:

"provide positive and stable family environments for the children and young people placed with our foster parents and ensure that, with the support of our foster parents, they can thrive emotionally and academically."

To provide this continuity, we focus on building and maintaining strong connections.

About the Role

We are looking for an organised and professional Panel Administrator to join our fostering services to provide maternity cover.

This role supports the smooth operation of fostering panels across Fosterplus and Clifford House Fostering. Working remotely, you will coordinate panel activity and manage complex administrative processes while supporting safeguarding standards and ensuring fostering decisions are underpinned by accurate and timely documentation.

We're looking for someone who can work effectively in a busy environment and brings exceptional attention to detail.

Role Responsibilities

As the Panel Administrator, you will provide administrative support to our fostering panels, ensuring meetings are effectively organised and managed.

Key responsibilities include:
- Coordinating fostering panel meetings and schedules
- Managing panel member attendance and ensuring panel quoracy
- Preparing, checking and distributing panel papers
- Producing timely and accurate minutes and records of panel discussions and recommendations
- Maintaining confidential records and electronic databases
- Liaising with social workers, Foster Parents, applicants, managers and independent panel members
- Monitoring documentation to ensure compliance with required standards and timescales
- Supporting the Panel Adviser and wider service with administrative and governance processes

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Highly organised with excellent administrative skills
- Experienced in managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines
- Confident in producing timely, professional minutes, reports and correspondence
- Able to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism
- A strong communicator with excellent written and verbal skills
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook and Teams
- Highly attentive to detail, with a commitment to accuracy and quality

Experience We're Looking For

Essential
- Experience supporting panels, committees, boards or senior management teams
- Experience organising meetings and managing agendas
- Experience taking formal minutes and maintaining accurate records
- Experience handling confidential information

Desirable
- Experience within fostering, adoption, children's social care or safeguarding services
- Understanding of fostering regulations, National Minimum Standards and panel processes
- Experience working with professionals across multiple agencies
- Relevant administration qualifications or professional minute-taking training

Fosterplus is an equal opportunities employer.

The successful applicant will be subject to an enhanced DBS check, the cost of which will be met by Fosterplus.

Fosterplus is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff to share this commitment.

We reserve the right to withdraw this advert without notification.

To provide general reception, call-handling and administrative support as required within the needs of the service and provide administrative support to members of the leadership team. Hand out clinician prescribed or issued medicines to patients where appropriate/required and in accordance with Trust Policy. Identify and refer to senior colleagues any young and/or vulnerable people complying with Cambridgeshire Community Services (CCS) safeguarding policies. To maintain patient notes according to the Trust Records Management Policy and have knowledge and experience of medical/sexual and reproductive health terminology.

title: Endoscopy Booking Clerk
description: The Endoscopy Department Booking Office is looking for two enthusiastic Booking Clerks to join their friendly team, working alongside other admin team members in a fast-paced office environment. The post holders will be part of the Endoscopy Administration Team and be responsible for the administration and upkeep of the Luton Endoscopy waiting list and booking of patients within the breach dates and through the correct pathways. The Booking Clerks will utilise the Patient Information Management System (IPM) to record waiting list information, whilst ensuring all patient information is up to date and any problems reported upwards. The post holders will liaise closely with all Consultants and users of the Endoscopy Unit to ensure that good communication is in place and assist with the implementation of new guidelines and policies to ensure targeted are met in line with National and Local Guidelines. Responsible for the booking of patients within the breach dates and through the correct pathways depending on the triage of referral. Report any potential breaches to the Administrative and Waiting List Leads. To work closely with the Endoscopy Compliance Lead, supporting them with any administration tasks including audio typing and sending out of letters. To take incoming telephone calls ensuring they are dealt with courteously and sensitive manner with due regard to confidentiality. Resolve enquiries from patients and provide advice, reassurance to patients, carers/relatives, who have concerns regarding appointments or procedures. When instructed by the Administrative and Waiting List Leads and/or the Endoscopy Operational Compliance Manager, moving patients appointment due to unforeseen circumstances. If cancelled on the day of appointment, contact patients directly, making sure patients are offered a date within appropriate time frame. To be responsible for ensuring that if a patient is unable to attend an appointment, the vacant slot is efficiently offered to another patient.
